name: Soft-Shelled Clam Meat
summary: Soft-Shelled Clam Meat makes tempting bait for the fish near Shadowprey Village. Mai'Lahii asks you to bring her some from the wrecked ship to the north.

sections.title: Bait for Mai'Lahii
sections.body: Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village favors soft-shelled clam meat for fishing. She says the fish cannot resist it, and asks you to bring her ten pieces from the clams near the wrecked ship north of the village.

faq.q: What is soft-shelled clam meat for?
faq.answer: Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village uses soft-shelled clam meat as bait for fishing.

faq.q: Where can I find soft-shelled clams?
faq.answer: Soft-shelled clams lie near the wrecked ship off the coast north of Shadowprey Village.
Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village asks you to bring her ten pieces of soft-shelled clam meat.

faq.q: Why does Mai'Lahii want to go fishing?
faq.answer: Mai'Lahii says her witch doctor advised her to go fishing for her headache, and she feels better after you bring the clam meat.
